directPlannedTargets.name: Kozhikode
directPlannedTargets.summary: The native geometry audit passed 280 parcel IDs across nine cells, but the ordinary 25-cell browser view timed out in two consecutive loads. It retained only 15 then 23 complete cells and displayed the normal unavailable-source warning. Some same-cell retries passed; reliable expanded viewport loading remains unverified. No timeout or failure handling is weakened.
directPlannedTargets.technicalDecision: Keep as verified research source without an app entry pending reliable expanded viewport loading.
